use.flag: Build the desktop application (Fyne, OpenGL, X11/Wayland); without it only multi2fa-cli is installed

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Multi2FA TOTP is an offline TOTP/HOTP authenticator. Accounts are kept in password protected vaults encrypted with Argon2id, scrypt or PBKDF2 and XChaCha20-Poly1305, AES-256-GCM or both in cascade, with an optional key file. The desktop app supports several vaults, nested folders, QR scanning from a camera, the screen, images and the clipboard, Google Authenticator exports, auto-lock and encrypted backups. multi2fa-cli lists accounts and prints codes from the same vaults in a terminal.
